DECLARE
 lv_colName VARCHAR2(30);
 lv_operator VARCHAR2(30);
 lv_sqlOper VARCHAR2(30);
 lv_value VARCHAR2(2000);
 lv_dataTable VARCHAR2(30);
 
 lv_tName VARCHAR2(30);
 lv_cName VARCHAR2(30);
 
 ln_seq NUMBER;
 ln_pos NUMBER;

 CURSOR sql_cur IS
 SELECT data_table_name, data_column_name, sql_stmt
 FROM emf_process_mapping
 WHERE process_code = :ctrl_blk.process_code
 AND mapping_name = :emf_source_process.looking_for; 
 
 lv_sql VARCHAR2(1000);
 ln_proc_seq NUMBER; 
BEGIN

 OPEN sql_cur;
 FETCH sql_cur INTO lv_tName, lv_cName, lv_sql;
 CLOSE sql_cur;
 --message('seq ' || :emf_source_process.process_seq);pause;
 IF lv_sql IS NOT NULL AND INSTR(:emf_source_process.process_seq,'.') = 0 THEN
 :emf_source_process.param_flag := 'Y';
 emf_util.tab_metadata(lv_sql, GLOBALVAR.data_tab);
 IF GLOBALVAR.data_tab.COUNT > 0 THEN
 --lv_data_table_name := GLOBALVAR.data_tab(1)(1);
 --FOR oindx IN 2 .. GLOBALVAR.data_tab.COUNT LOOP
 FOR oindx IN 1 .. GLOBALVAR.data_tab.COUNT LOOP 
 lv_dataTable := GLOBALVAR.data_tab(oindx)(1); 
 lv_colName:= GLOBALVAR.data_tab(oindx)(2);
 lv_operator := GLOBALVAR.data_tab(oindx)(3);
 lv_value := GLOBALVAR.data_tab(oindx)(4);
 ln_seq := :emf_source_process.process_seq;
 CREATE_RECORD;
 :emf_source_process.process_seq := ln_seq + 0.01;
 --CREATE_RECORD;
 :emf_source_process.data_table_name := lv_dataTable;
 ln_pos := INSTR(lv_colName, '.');
 
 IF ln_pos <> 0 THEN
 :emf_source_process.data_column_name := SUBSTR(lv_colName, ln_pos+1);
 ELSE
 :emf_source_process.data_column_name := lv_colName;
 END IF;
 
 IF INSTR(lv_operator, ':P_OPER_') = 0 THEN
 /*
 CASE lv_operator
 WHEN '=' THEN
 lv_sqlOper := 'EQ';
 WHEN '!=' THEN
 lv_sqlOper := 'NE';
 WHEN '<' THEN
 lv_sqlOper := 'LT';
 WHEN '>' THEN
 lv_sqlOper := 'GT';
 WHEN '<=' THEN
 lv_sqlOper := 'LE';
 WHEN '>=' THEN
 lv_sqlOper := 'GE';
 WHEN 'IN' THEN
 lv_sqlOper := 'ANY OF';
 ELSE -- ALL OF, IN, NOT IN, COUNT GE, COUNT LE, COUNT LT , COUNT EQ
 lv_sqlOper := lv_operator;
 END CASE;*/
 :emf_source_process.sql_oper := lv_operator;
 END IF;

 IF INSTR(lv_value, ':P_VALUE_') = 0 THEN
 :emf_source_process.response := lv_value;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 
/*
 emf_util.tab_metadata( 'CHAG', data_tab );
 
 IF data_tab.count > 0 THEN
 lv_data_table_name := data_tab(1)(1);
 FOR oindx IN 2 .. data_tab.COUNT LOOP
 lv_col_name := data_tab(oindx)(1);
 lv_oper_name := data_tab(oindx)(2);
 lv_value := data_tab(oindx)(3);
 message(lv_value);pause;
 
 :emf_source_process.data_table_name := lv_data_table_name;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
*/
 --MESSAGE('TABLE NAME ' || data_tab(1)(1));
 --MESSAGE('First row ' || data_tab(2)(1) || '--' || data_tab(2)(2) || '---' || data_tab(2)(3));
 /*
 FOR oindx IN 1 .. data_tab.COUNT LOOP
 FOR iindx IN 1 .. data_tab(oindx).COUNT LOOP
 
 DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('data_tab(' || ltrim(to_char(oindx))
 || ')(' || ltrim(to_char(iindx))
 || ') -> ' || data_tab(oindx)(iindx) );
 END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
 */
 ELSE
 :emf_source_process.data_table_name := lv_tName;
 :emf_source_process.data_column_name := lv_cName; 
 next_item;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DELREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 nDelRecSeq NUMBER := :EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ;
 nFloorSeq NUMBER ;
 --nCurrFloorSeq NUMBER;
 --nRoundSeq NUMBER;
BEGIN
 
 --nFloorSeq := FLOOR(nDelRecSeq);
 
 IF FLOOR(nDelRecSeq) = nDelRecSeq THEN -- header record
 DELETE_RECORD;
 /*
 LOOP
 EXIT WHEN ROUND(:EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ) <> nSeq;
 DELETE_RECORD;
 END LOOP;
 */
 LOOP
 nFloorSeq := FLOOR(:EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ);
 
 IF nFloorSeq = nDelRecSeq THEN
 DELETE_RECORD;
 IF :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE' THEN
 DELETE_RECORD;
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 
 ELSIF nFloorSeq > nDelRecSeq THEN
 :EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ := :EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ - 1;
 IF :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE' THEN 
 EXIT;
 ELSE
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 EXIT; 
 END IF;
 
 END LOOP;
 
/* 
 IF ROUND(:EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ) > nSeq THEN -- if 2 is deleted, decrease the sequence for number greater than 2 only.
 LOOP
 :EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ := :EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ - 1;
 IF :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE' THEN 
 EXIT;
 ELSE
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END IF;
 
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 */
 --MESSAGE('SEQ NO ' || :EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ);PAUSE;
 ELSE 
 DELETE_RECORD;
 LOOP
 -- message('seq no ' || :EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ);PAUSE;
 -- message('N seq no ' || nSeq );PAUSE;
 --nCurrFloorSeq := FLOOR(:EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ);
 IF FLOOR(:EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ) = :EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ THEN --header record
 EXIT;
 ELSIF :EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ < nDelRecSeq THEN
 EXIT;
 ELSIF :EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ > nDelRecSeq THEN
 IF FLOOR(:EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ) = FLOOR(nDelRecSeq) THEN
 :EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ := :EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ - 0.01;
 ELSE
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 IF :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE' THEN
 EXIT;
 ELSE
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END IF;
 END LOOP; 
 /*
 LOOP
 -- message('seq no ' || :EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ);PAUSE;
 -- message('N seq no ' || nSeq );PAUSE;
 EXIT WHEN ROUND(:EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ) <> ROUND(nSeq);
 :EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ := :EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ - 0.01;
 --MESSAGE('before next record ' || :EMF_SOURCE_PROCESS.PROCESS_SEQ);PAUSE;
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END LOOP;
 */
 END IF;
END;

PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Causing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) = 'CHANGED' ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Cursor_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;
